d: Eusino Riviera with a thick forest, cluttering the whole scene. Farnace with a naked sword in his hand, then Tamiri.

Guastatori come out, which cutting short the forest reduce it to an open countryside, seeing at the bottom of the sea, and in it the naval army of Berenice, and on the one hand the city of Heraclea with bridge, which introduces into the same. They land the ships, and throw the bridges disembark on the shore the Army, and then disembark from rich Berenice ship, and Gilade with numerous royal Accompaniment.
Pompey, Aquilio with the Roman Army and sayings.
Aquilio with Selinda on the side of the city, Berenice on the other side with Séguito, Pompey, Gilade, and Soldiers on the field.
Place of the mausoleum, in the midst of which there is a great pyramid for the tomb of the kings of Pontus. Tamiri alone his little Son led by hand by a Servant.
Pompey with Séguito, and so on.
Spacious place of architecture in the palace. Selinda, Gilade, and Aquilio.
Mausolei with the pyramid destined for the tomb of the kings of Pontus. Farnace.
Berenice with the Child, Pompey with Aquilio, and Selinda.
Piazza d'Eraclea with trophies, and other triumphal apparatuses. Pompey, Berenice, Gilade, Aquilio followed by both victorious Exercises.
Tamiri with Servi, who bring many precious gifts. Pompey with his Following, and Aquilio.
Rooms corresponding to gardens, Selinda, and Gilade.
Aquilio, then Pompey, and then on the other side Farnace.
Royal pavilions. Berenice sitting in the seat over a few steps; Farnace chained between Guards.
Pompey with some Guards, and sayings.
Gilade, and Selinda, with numerous followers all with bare arms, and sayings.
